message:
A stage of the incident summarizer chain is erroring: {{functionname.name}}.

All eight functions report under `service:incident-summarizer` (RC1-411 set DD_SERVICE in the SAM Globals), so this is grouped by `functionname` to name the stage rather than the chain. The chain is ingest -> normalizer -> dedup -> summarizer -> jiracreator / slacknotifier / datadogevents; a failure upstream starves everything after it.

Note the circularity: this alert routes through the summarizer's own webhook, so if the receiver or ingest stage is the one failing, read the Lambda logs directly instead of waiting for a summary.

RC1-457. @webhook-incident-summarizer
name: Incident summarizer — Lambda errors by stage
